IRS990.Desc: FOR MORE THAN 35 YEARS, LEAD SAN DIEGO HAS SERVED AS AN INCUBATOR FOR COMMUNITY LEADERSHIP. LEAD IS THE ONLY ORGANIZATION IN THE SAN DIEGO/NOTHERN BAJA CALIFORNIA REGION SOLELLY DEDICATED TO DEVELOPING ENGAGED CIVIC AND COMMUNITY LEADERS. WITH A PORTFOLIO OF UNPARALLELED PROGRAMS DESIGNED FOR INDIVIDUALS AT VARIOUS LEVELS OF PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT AND COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT, LEAD SAN DIEGO FILLS THE REGION'S LEADERSHIP PIPELINE BY PROVIDING BALANCED EDUCATION AND DIALOGUE ON ISSUES OF CRITICAL REGIONAL IMPORTANCE, HELPING A CROSS-SECTION OF LEADERS BECOME BETTER INFORMED AND ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN WORK THAT POSITIVELY IMPACTS OUR COMMUNITIES. THROUGH LEAD'S VARIOUS PROGRAMS, FORUMS, ALUMNI ASSOCIATION MEMBERSHIP AND THE ANNUAL VISIONARY AWARDS, WHICH IS SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA'S PREMIER LEADERSHIP RECOGNITION EVENT, LEAD PERSONALLY REACHED APPOXIMATELY 1,400 MEMBERS DURING THE YEAR. THOUSANDS MORE ARE REACHED EACH YEAR VIA LEAD SAN DIEGO'S WEBSITE AND REGULAR E-COMMUNICATIONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: LEAD SAN DIEGO IS A NON-PROFIT CORPORATION ORGANIZED UNDER THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA AND IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. THE ORGANIZATION DOES NOT HAVE ANY UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS AT DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH TAX MATTERS AS PART OF OPERATING EXPENSES AND INCLUDES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES WITH THE RELATED TAX LIABILITY IN THE CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF FINANCIAL POSITION. NO SUCH AMOUNTS ARE INCLUDED IN THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024 AND 2023.

TO MAINTAIN PURCHASING POWER(REAL VALUE) OF THE ENDOWMENT FUNDS AND DISBURSE 5% ANNUALLY BASED ON MARKET VALUE OVER PREVIOUS 36 MONTHS. IF THE MARKET DECLINES, DISTRIBUTIONS ARE LIMITED TO INCOME RECEIVED SUCH AS INTEREST AND DIVIDENDS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: PRIOR TO FILING, DRAFTS OF THE 990 ARE SHARED WITH THE CEO, COO, AND THE FINANCE COMMITTEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: LEAD SAN DIEGO EXPECTS THE PRIMARY INTEREST OF EMPLOYEES AND DIRECTORS TO BE THE INDIVIDUALS LEAD SERVES. A CONFLICT OF INTEREST OCCURS WHEN THE INTERESTS OF AN EMPLOYEE, DIRECTOR OR ANOTHER PARTY ACTUALLY OR POTENTIALLY AFFECT LEAD SAN DIEGO IN A NEGATIVE WAY AS DEFINED IN SECTION 8.9 OF LEAD SAN DIEGO'S BYLAWS. PRIOR TO CONSUMMATING ANY SUCH TRANSACTION, THE INDIVIDUAL MUST OBTAIN APPROVAL BY VOTE OF A MAJORITY OF THE DIRECTORS THEN IN OFFICE WITHOUT COUNTING THE VOTE OF THE INDIVIDUAL INVOLVED. IF APPROVAL IS NOT OBTAINED, THE DIRECTOR IN QUESTION MAY BE REQUIRED TO DO SUCH THINGS AN PAY SUCH DAMAGES AS, IN THE DISCRETION OF HTE COURT, WILL PROVIDE AN EQUITABLE AND FAIR REMEDY TO LEAD SAN DIEGO. ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND EMPLOYEES ARE MADE AWARE ON A YEARLY BASIS THAT THESE BY-LAWS ARE IN EFFECT.
